note: Reference results read when RUN_ENDPOINT_EVAL is False. These metrics are computed from tuned_reference_rows.json in this directory, and judge_reference_metrics.json judges those same generations, so the three files describe one run. The checkpoint was trained with the recipe as shipped, one epoch on ml.g5.2xlarge, served on ml.g5.xlarge. Running notebooks 1 to 4 end to end on a fresh checkpoint reproduced 87.57 / 76.37 / 71.00 / 100.0, so expect movement of a few tenths.
